description: The plot illustrates the impact of hyperparameter N on AUC, with the x-axis labeled 'N' and the y-axis labeled 'AUC (%)'. The x-axis is linear, ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5, while the y-axis is also linear, ranging from 75 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 5. Five lines are shown, each representing a different dataset or model, distinguished by different colors and markers. The blue line with circle markers starts at around 94% at N=1, increases to 99% at N=10, and then decreases to 94% at N=20. The red line with square markers begins at around 86% at N=1, rises to 99% at N=10, and then drops to 91% at N=20. The orange line with diamond markers starts at 85% at N=1, increases to 95% at N=10, and remains relatively steady, ending at 95% at N=20. The green line with star markers begins at 84% at N=1, increases to 93% at N=10, and continues to rise to 94% at N=20. The purple line with triangle markers starts at 80% at N=1, remains relatively stable until N=5, then sharply increases to 96% at N=10, before decreasing to 80% at N=20.
